notes.title: The Chasm Update
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone! Got some fresh new content, fixes, and polish for ya. There is also some extra information at the bottom of the patch notes regarding the new map coming next week![/p][p][b]ADDED[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added ChasmCaller Item (Allows for quick travel)[/p][list][*][p]Bought as a tentacle looking thing from the shop (1 Per game) [/p][/*][*][p]Left click with item in hand to place the first “gate” then left click again w[/p][/*][*][p]Going into one gate will allow you to “travel” to the other gate rapidly[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]New Upgrade texture for Line and Rod. (Stealth added last patch)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Each of the 7 rod and line upgrades will change how the rod/line look![/p][/*][*][p]Added a Progress bar to show casting power progress[/p][/*][*][p]Added Bait box VFX[/p][/*][*][p]Now when starting new game if the player has no saves it will skip the “Load save” screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Fish caught on Average angler (This difficulty used to be called First time fisher) Will now show up on leaderboard.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an extra tab that shows the effects of each difficulty. (Question mark button on next to difficulty on server creation screen.)[/p][/*][*][p]Added SFX when jump connects with ground[/p][/*][*][p]Added Unique SFX for walking/jumping on beds[/p][/*][*][p]Added Splash VFX and SFX when jumping and Running in water.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Drowning PostProcessing VFX[/p][/*][*][p]ChasmCaller page to the Journal (press G in game).
[/p][/*][/list][p][b]FIXES[/b][/p][list][*][p][i]FIXED BUG WHERE CLIENTS COULD NOT UPGRADE?[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Turned Physics Simulation off when bobber hits water. ( This will fix a alot of the issues where the bobber hits the shores and spins off into the distance, This will also allow people to fish in way more areas and allow them to fish further from shore ) .[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Bluetooth Fishing (Players not being able to see other players actively fishing)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Bug where Shark attack would sometimes be silent[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Animation Bug where if you swapped item slot mid cast, then go back to fishing pole, it would be stuck in “full cast” animation.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Bug Where Wood footsteps would not play in cabin [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Bug where The proper amount of gold would not be taken from player when buying upgrades (it was subtracting gold as if there was only 1 player in the game!)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where the fish point value of a fish would not always be correct or would reset after gambling it.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where the butcher table and large grill would appear in the shop after loading a saved game even if the player had bought them on the previous save[/p][/*][*][p]Weather Slider now turns down weather:)[/p][/*][*][p]Sticky Hook Perk on Client[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Mermaid changing value in hand.
[/p][/*][/list][p][b] BALANCE CHANGES [/b](Let us know if you have any suggestions)[/p][list][*][p]Shark Attack now only kills on fishing veteran and Jeremy Wade Difficulties[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Base Value of Great White Shark by 25%[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Base Value of MolaMola by 10%[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased Based Value of Muskellunge by 25%[/p][/*][*][p]Mola Mola now “Tires” 20% faster.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]The new map “The Canyons” is scheduled to be released on the 4th of October! It is just needing a few more creatures along with some additional testing before it will be pushed to live.
This map is going to be a bit different from what you are used with gone fishing. This map will include new types of dangers such as aerial creatures and rock slides. This map is very linear and was designed with the intention of players using the new tunnel item to better navigate the map. In addition, this map takes a new spin on the day night cycle. Rather than the shark creature coming out at 22:00 to hunt down players who have yet to hide in the cabin, players will be able to fish much later into the night. Given this, other creatures will become progressively more hostile the later it gets. The intention with this design is to force players into more intense situations by forcing them to fish later in the night without the soft lock that the shark creature presents. You can expect 33% shorter day times but an additional 50% more time at night before the shark creature comes out.[/p][list][*][p]New content on the map:[/p][list][*][p]8 new bait types[/p][/*][*][p]3 new creatures/monsters[/p][/*][*][p]10 new fish[/p][/*][*][p]Lots of other new stuff:)[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p]In addition, the portals you are used to using as fast travel will soon serve a new purpose. As of now the portals teleport you back to the cabin, however, as I finish up work on the expansion areas for each map, these portals will teleport you to new areas on the same map. For example, on the Jungle map, the portal will teleport you to a volcanic island which will have both high tier bait and fish as well as new dangers. The primary bottleneck as of now is of course, the creatures. They take the most time to create and implement by far however I am hoping to have expansion areas for all of the maps released before the end of October.[/p][p]
Thanks![/p]

notes.title: THE BAIT UPDATE and more...
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone, got some fresh new content and fixes for ya! expect lots more soon :)

Added a new bait type for each creature in the game:[/p][p]-Ivan[/p][p]-Hand Face[/p][p]-Mama crocodile[/p][p]-Mama python[/p][p]-Giant gorilla[/p][p]-Giant tarantula[/p][p]-Serphant[/p][p]This means that when you blow up and kill a creature, you can now use their corpse as bait (and darn good bait it is)
[/p][p]Buffed the value of medium sized chopped bait from 35 to 40[/p][p]Buffed the weight curve of mola mola, the max weight is still the same but the changes of catching a larger one is higher.[/p][p]Increased the quota growth factor from a random float in range 3:5 to 5:7 for fish catching machine (fcm) difficulty[/p][p]Increased the bonus value of fish from 1.2x to 1.25x  when playing on fcm difficulty[/p][p]Increased bait score bonus from 1.1x to 1.15x when playing on fcm difficulty[/p][p][/p][p]Added new area where players can fish from the mountain shack on the jungle map. You may have noticed you could’nt catch any fish up there, this is because it simply takes much to long to real the bobber up the mountain side. The game detects if the fish is caught by calculating the distance from you and the bobber using the x and y coords (ignoring z). This means that as long as the bobber is close to you (regardless of height difference) the fish will be caught. This means you should look for areas with a very steep slop that way you dont have to reel the bobber up the mountain
[/p][p]Fixed various issues with the save system. It should correctly load client inventories and upgrades. There is still an issue where fish point values will be set back to default for clients. The current work around is to have the host simply pick up and drop each fish. Once the fish has been dropped clients will see the correct point value for the fish. I will try to have this fixed asap

Fixed bug that caused clients to crash when they were the first player to enter a radius near the boat.[/p][p]Fixed bug where fish caught on peaceful difficulty would be added to the leaderboard[/p][p]Fixed bug where client would not always receive the fish bonus weight buff from playing on fcm[/p][p]Fixed an issue that led to chopped meat bait falling through the floor for clients.[/p][p]Foxed an issue where crushed beer cans could collide with boats and other entities and cause weird physics.[/p][p]Fixed a bug where the trader would let players go into debt (gambling addicts…..)[/p][p]Fixed bug where the bone could fall through the floor for clients on loading into the world[/p][p]Fixed bug where the blown up boulder would reappear upon loading a saved game[/p][p][/p][p]Added some logic to check if a player is ejected from the crabboat on the jungle map upon exiting the drivers seat. If the player is below the boat, it will teleport the player back to the boat.[/p][p][/p][p]Ya’ll got me thinking about quitting my job so I can spend more time working on gone fishing lol, thank you again for all the support!!![/p][p]
[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Nydus Worm, Balancing and Fixes
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone, have some new content for you!

Added new item: The Nydus Horn. This horn can be used to summon Nydus worms that will grab fish on the ground in an area around you then return them to the cabin. How does it work? Let's say you have 5 fish on the ground near you. When you blow the horn, multiple Nydus worms will travel to your location underground then come up through the ground. For each fish on the ground near you, a worm will be summoned to grab each fish. The worms will then travel back to the cabin and drop the fish off. Treat the Nydus worms well so they do not betray you.[/p][list][*][p]With the new item backend finally created for the shop, you can expect to see many more items in the shop in the next few updates![/p][/*][/list][p]Balance pass on solo play: Changed how daylight works when playing in single player. You can expect to have the normal day length of playing in multiplayer with an additional 90 seconds of daylight.
[/p][p]Increased starting gold from 5->10
[/p][p]Fixed bug where starting a new game would give you items from a previous run (save game bug)[/p][p]Fixed bug on Jungle map where solo players would only have 11 minutes of day light regardless of difficulty chosen.[/p][p]Fixed bug where updating the game could reset your settings[/p][p]Fixed bug where sound would be 0 at default for some players
Fixed bug where dying to the shark monster could cause weird issues for the player
Fixed bug that could cause a crash on the main menu[/p][p]Fixed more edge cases that could cause a players fishing ui not to be visible
[/p][p]Updated all languages to the current version of the game[/p][p]
Thanks![/p]

notes.title: ALPHA 2.0 Is HERE!!!
notes.content:
[p]Hello Everyone! We have made a lot of progress and are happy to bring this new update to y’all. This update contains lots of new content, polish, and bug fixes. Unfortunately, my brother ran into some pretty serious issues with the fishing system overhaul, so much of that is being pushed back until we can ensure it is an enjoyable and polished experience. As of this update, I am now working on a save system and will push it live as soon as I have it in a good state.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Content in this patch…

Added new map:[/p][p]      The Jungle:[/p][list][*][p]The jungle contains 11 new bait types, 10 new fish, and two new creatures[/p][/*][*][p]The jungle adds a new item, TNT[/p][/*][*][p]Adds a new obstacle to progression. Players must blow up trees with TNT off a rope bridge so they can access the rest of the map. There is a painting in the cabin to give players a hint on where to find the TNT. TNT has 4 unique spawn locations.[/p][/*][*][p]TNT can now kill the giant python, crocodile, giant gorilla, giant tarantula, and other players. The “kill zone” of TNT is 700 in-game units, or roughly the distance a player can cover in one second of sprinting. The fuse time of TNT is a total of 3 seconds, so players must run away quickly after igniting the TNT. If you use TNT on your friend who is fishing, I am not responsible.[/p][/*][*][p]In order to accommodate for the new ocean giants, upgrade levels have been increased from a max of 5 -> 6. New bait types like Baby Gorilla and Capybara have a score between 25 and 35% larger than the previous best bait.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a portal that has a chance to teleport the player to the cabin or altar. It can be activated by dropping a fish near the portal. It will remain active for 30 seconds.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p]Added 11 new bait types:[/p][olist][*][p]Baby Gorilla[/p][/*][*][p]Human- You can now pick up your friend's corpse to use as bait[/p][/*][*][p]Ant Eater[/p][/*][*][p]Armadillo[/p][/*][*][p]Capybara[/p][/*][*][p]Cassowary[/p][/*][*][p]Dart Frog[/p][/*][*][p]Ant[/p][/*][*][p]Iguana[/p][/*][*][p]Squirrel[/p][/*][*][p]Turantula[/p][/*][/olist][p]
[/p][p]Added 10 new fish types:[/p][olist][*][p]Coral Grouper[/p][/*][*][p]Dogtooth Tuna[/p][/*][*][p]Napoleon Wrasse[/p][/*][*][p]Giant Trevally Jack[/p][/*][*][p]Spanish Mackerel[/p][/*][*][p]Giant Mekong Catfish[/p][/*][*][p]Shortfin Mako Shark[/p][/*][*][p]Mola Mola (Sunfish)[/p][/*][*][p]Flounder[/p][/*][*][p]Striped bass[/p][/*][/olist][p]
[/p][list][*][p]Peacock Bass added to the Swamp[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p]Added two new creatures:[/p][olist][*][p]Giant Tarantula[/p][/*][*][p]Giant Gorilla (It's Harambe, welcome back, brother)[/p][/*][/olist][p]

[/p][p]Added new boat type:[/p][olist][*][p]Ocean fishing vessel. Boats can still be buggy for clients. This can be resolved by having the host drive the boat instead of a client.[/p][/*][/olist][p]
[/p][p]Polish:[/p][olist][*][p]Added microphone selection option in the options menu[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the bait system to remove duplication exploits and save on cpu performance. Previously, the bait system was fairly heavy on the cpu but should run much smoother now.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked how fish are caught and dropped. Previously, when a player left clicked, the fish would be dropped on the ground. Now, if the player has an empty inventory slot the fish will be added directly to the inventory and the players current inventory slot will be updated to the slot that the fish was added. This should fix issues related to fish disappearing and falling into areas the player did not intend.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new input prompt system. When you have an item equipped or look at an item or interactable, it will display the appropriate key(s) from your key bindings intrusting you on how to interact with the given item. For example, when you look at the dog, it will tell you how to change the dog’s mode, state, and owner. Also, when you have for example a fish equipped, it will tell you how to drop the fish and how to throw it.[/p][/*][*][p]Revamped and polished the UI for perks[/p][/*][*][p]Bait AI was also reworked and should also use less cpu resources.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated bait pictures so they are all standardized[/p][/*][*][p]Removed player collision from several items to prevent buggy physics[/p][/*][*][p]Changed Proximity chat to toggle instead of push to talk[/p][/*][*][p]Added icon on the bottom left of the players screen to let them know when prox chat is on[/p][/*][*][p]Updated sound effects for Ivan (Wheeping angel on the lake map)[/p][/*][*][p]Added lanterns to respawn areas so that players can see[/p][/*][*][p]Added new paintings to the cabin[/p][/*][*][p]Changed size of Perch and PaddleFish so they more accurately reflect there value[/p][/*][*][p]Made so players can walk out of the gambling pool rather than having to jump out

[/p][/*][/olist][p]Tweaks:[/p][list][*][p]Holding LMB to throw fish now MAX charges in ~2.5 seconds instead of ~5.5.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced Base Cast distance by ~33%[/p][/*][*][p]Night time creatures will now spawn 30 seconds sooner[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p]Fixed bugs:[/p][olist][*][p]Fish despawning for clients bug is now fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Proximity chat. Prox chat would often seem laggy or cut out previously.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where a client's gambled fish would not have the correct point value[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where a client’s cooked fish would not have the correct point value[/p][/*][*][p]Client bait score variance[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where you couldn’t see other players' baits. When requipping Rod.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bait duplication exploit[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various fish duplication exploits[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an edge case where player movement could be glitchy when they have a fish on hook. [/p][/*][*][p]Some fish that were placed on the edge of the gambling pool would not be registered[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where game could end unexpectedly [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where dog could cause lanterns to become uninteractable[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where a player could die while entering the boat. On the client side, they would be in the boat but the server would not [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various bugs with the end-game leaderboard[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where clients could remain attached to crocs if the croc failed to kill them[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the piranha and cockroach event could fire when the player was not at ground level[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where the terrorist’s (little creature guy who you feed fish to) sound effects were global instead of local[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where the proper day length was not set based off difficulty and number of players in the lobby[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed End game Fish images being white or stretched.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where fire could be blue yet the game thought quota wasn't met.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where ravens that fly around the altar when quota is met did not despawn the next day[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where the dog could get stuck in the gambling pool[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where quota did not always scale to the number of players[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where cave monster could get stuck on the ramp[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where a player would not fully die when attacked by Ivan[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Duplicating Perks[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where perks could show up as duplicates in the perk selection menu[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where discord button could disappear when hovered over[/p][/*][/olist][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Updates and fixes
notes.content:
Hey All!

I have a few updates for you today as we continue to work towards the next big update which were still hoping to have live in two weeks time.

If you are noticing any performance issues, please add “-dx11” to your launch options.

Whats in todays update?

New item: Depth Finder. When the depth finder is in your inventory, a small ui popup will be displayed indicating how deep the water is where your bobber is. The ui will be visible once your bobber hits the water. Remember, deeper water equal bigger fish (amongst other factors aswell)

New sound effects for bait when it is hooked.

Major polish to the dog. He will now properly pickup and return fish to the altar. The dogs animations were slightly improved and he is now a better swimmer. Press “f” on the dog to set you as the owner and press “E” on the dog to switch the dog between lantern and fish mode.

Fixed the bug where the monster could get stuck when attempting to grab a player from the cabin (thanks duklock for reporting this)

Fixed bug where some monsters (not lake monster) could kill the player while the player was in bed

Other various bug fixes.
____________________________________________________________________________
Progress on the next big update:

The new fishing system has been made and is now being migrated into our existing project. The new system involves entirely new mechanics and will perform much better than the existing system.

The new map “The Jungle” is almost complete. The landscape, bait spawning, monster spawning, and unique content are all complete and just needs to be polished and optimized now.

8 new bait types have been added. Since the new map will focus heavily on ocean fishing, many of the new bait types are much larger than you're used to. Get ready to fish using mammals as bait.

New fish are being made daily, there will be a total of atleast 8 new fish for the new map.

Two new creatures are already implemented
A new ocean capable fishing boat has also been added.

New items including TNT (blowing up your friends while they are fishing is optional).

The rest will just have to be a surprise

Thank you to everyone for being so patient with the development process and getting back to us with valuable feedback, we couldnt do it without you, like seriously.

notes.title: Updates to the fishing system, polish, and bug fixes!
notes.content:
[p]

We have made quite a few changes since the last update two days ago.

For starters, we noticed quite a large issue with the algorithm that determines the type and weight of fish you catch. At the moment, every few seconds, we simulate a random type of fish (based on the bait you are using, the depth of the water, the current weather, the current day number, totem upgrades, and personal upgrades) to bite your line. Once a random fish is chosen to bite your line, you are then prompted with the fishing minigame. Unfortunately, there were some issues with our math that determined which fish we selected to bite your line. This issue is now resolved and you should reliably catch fish based on the multiple inputs that go into the equation. How will this affect your gameplay? It will lead to more reliable catches based on the choices you make when fishing. It will make it much easier to target and catch a specific kind of fish as well as make it easier to catch much larger fish.

In addition, fish type and fish size WILL NOW scale with the day count. This means you can expect to catch larger fish as your play through continues.[/p][p]
[/p][p]Other changes and fixes:
Map selection polish
Throwing fish polish
Dropping items polish
Rebalance of a few fish on the swamp map
Buffed the positive effects of fish caught during a thunderstorm.
Changed drowning time from 7->10 seconds
Increased movement speed of player when under water.
Size of fish in hand and on line polish
Collision fixes on swamp map
Replacement of old bait system to new bait system (all baits can now be picked up and used properly)
Fixed typo with the “met snake” achievement not unlocking
Fixed bug where the most recently added fish would be gambled instead of the first fish placed in.
Fixed bug where game might not pause for clients when host pauses the session
Fixed bug where players could not rejoin a game after being disconnected (Players used to have to relaunch their game to rejoin).
Fixed bug where skin walkers and serpents could spawn infinitely.
Fixed bug where fish could fall off boats.
Fixed bug where minnows had a chance not to be added to inventory.
Fixed bug where crocodile might not growl when players got close.
Fixed bug where players could fall through the map after being grabbed by the crab.
Fixed bug where duckling bait could interact with boat when player casted their line.
Fixed issue where “My Catches” tab on leaderboard did not load properly.
Fixed bug where crocodile would kill the player twice causing them to bug out.
Fixed bug where players could not spectate players driving boats.
Fixed issue where certain bait would not spawn sometimes.
Removed fish stealer until it is reworked.
Fixed bug where player could store more bait then they were allowed to.
Fixed bug where fish could be duped.
Fixed bug where “Sinker” upgrade would not give its full upgrade value.
Rebalanced gambling. Made the odds 80/20 (loss/win) instead of 60/20. Made so max win is x3 instead of x5.
Random assortment of other small issues…

We are aware of a few bugs that we are work in progress on:
Boats might not load in the proper location when joining a session late.
Fish have a chance to disappear when playing on high ping.
Gambled fish have a chance to make the altar value negative

If you run into bugs please feel free to report them in the discord or on the steam discussion board. We are working as fast as we can to get everything patched asap for everyone!
Thank you for being patient with us. Have a great day!






[/p][p]
[/p]

Added settings for Brightness, Gamma, FPS Limit, Bloom, and Motion Blur.

Introduced an Easy Mode that significantly extends day length for a more relaxed experience.
